notes.title: v2.0.0.1 RELEASED
v2.0.0.1 RELEASED
Defense Warfare is taking a turn towards hero defenses!
notes.notes: Right now, I'm working day and night to turn this tower defense into a hero defense, with customizeable abilities... bringing a lot of new mechanics to the game. I'm going to gradually implement the new updates with update rounds around the middle of this month, when the game's launch period ends.

notes.title: Defense Warfare fully released!
notes.notes:
It has been a successful month since the game went out as Early Access. Lots of content has been added and I believe the title is ready to be fully released. The regularity of future updates highly depends on how the game performs on the market. Nevertheless, future updates are already planned and my main focus will be to bring more levels to the game. A scoring system has already been added and leaderboards (for the survival maps) are planned.
A big shout out to all the people who supported the game during it's Early Access period.
